title: Delegation of Powers by the Chief Commissioner

content.scenario: The Chief Commissioner of the Central Authority delegates his powers of general superintendence to a Commissioner, allowing for more efficient management of administrative matters.
content.outcome: The Chief Commissioner may delegate his powers relating to administrative matters of the Central Authority to any Commissioner or other officer, as he may think fit, enabling more effective administration of the Central Authority.

user_queries: Can the Chief Commissioner delegate his powers?
To whom can the Chief Commissioner delegate his powers?
